# Unresolved relationships keep their authored identities even when their
# diagnostics identify the same originating ticket as the path.
exit 1 ctx orient --bundle bundle
! stderr .
stdout -count=2 '^  error unsupported_source:$'
stdout 'link "https://one.example/requirements"'
stdout 'link "https://two.example/requirements"'

# Relationships that resolve to one source still group across commitments.
exit 1 ctx orient --bundle shared
! stderr .
stdout -count=1 '^  error source_missing:$'
stdout 'source: missing.md'
! stdout 'link "missing.md"'
! stdout 'link "./missing.md"'

# Unknown state on uncommitted work remains visible through reader diagnostics.
exit 1 ctx orient --bundle uncommitted
! stderr .
stdout 'error invalid_profile:'
stdout 'WorkItem requires a valid execution'
stdout 'source: work.md'

-- bundle/project.md --
---
type: Project
id: grouping-project
title: Grouping project
---
## Goals
Keep distinct relationships visible.
## Current commitments
- [Work](work.md)
## Open decisions
None

---

## Spec
- [One](https://one.example/requirements)
- [Two](https://two.example/requirements)
## Blocked by
None
## Blocked by decisions
None
